items.q: I remember I wrote that "Cavernism" arrangement for Willie Bryant's band, after I joined Willie Bryant

ctx.x: I remember I wrote that "Cavernism" arrangement for Willie Bryant's band, after I joined Willie Bryant -- I liked "Cavernism" so much ...
Well, when did you join Terry ... that's another story, I guess, huh?
